summary:
Etsy is the handmade marketplace at etsy.com. Shop owners look up the orange wordmark when a shop-manager bookmark loses its icon. Only downloaded image files are listed.

Checked 12 November 2026 against etsy.com. HTML came from https://www.etsy.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

A request to the favicon.ico URL https://www.etsy.com/favicon.ico returned png (20×20, 419 bytes), not an ICO container. Formats that saved: png.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.etsy.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 57×57 png.

Brand colour #ff6600 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-57x57-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-57x57-01.png at 57×57 (png, 368 bytes) from https://www.etsy.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
